import bpy, math

def mat(name, color, metal=0.0, rough=0.5):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = color
    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    m.diffuse_color = color
    return m

old = bpy.data.objects.get("Cube")
if old:
    bpy.data.objects.remove(old, do_unlink=True)

plat_m = mat("Platform", (0.8, 0.8, 0.82, 1), 0.2, 0.3)
body_m = mat("RoverBody", (0.0, 0.1, 1.0, 1), 0.3, 0.35)
wheel_m = mat("Wheel", (0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 1), 0.0, 0.8)

# Platform: top surface at z=0.2
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=3, depth=0.2, location=(0, 0, 0.1))
plat = bpy.context.object; plat.name = "Platform"; plat.data.materials.append(plat_m)

# Wheels: radius 0.4, sit on platform top (z=0.2) -> centre z=0.6
wr, wx, wy = 0.4, 0.8, 1.1
wz = 0.2 + wr
for i, (sx, sy) in enumerate([(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=wr, depth=0.35, location=(sx*wx, sy*wy, wz),
                                        rotation=(math.radians(90), 0, 0))
    w = bpy.context.object; w.name = f"Wheel_{i+1}"; w.data.materials.append(wheel_m)

# Body
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0, 0, wz + 0.35))
body = bpy.context.object; body.name = "RoverBody"
body.scale = (1.2, 1.5, 0.35)
body.data.materials.append(body_m)
print([o.name for o in bpy.data.objects])
